verdict.rationale: Proxy failover is a fair question for a cloud browser platform like Browserbase, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions proxies, proxy chains, or automatic retry when anti-bot detection blocks a request. The only nearby claim is CAPTCHA and login handling, which is a different capability from proxy-chain failover.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
